scolopsis_bimaculata.distribution: East and West coasts of India
field_marks: Blue stripe joining the eyes
1–2 brownish blotches on the upper body
Colour: upper body grey, whitish below, with a blue stripe joining the eyes
Body shape fusiform / normal; cross-section oval
Large suborbital spine present
Antrorse (forward-directed) suborbital spine absent
Head scales reach forward to the posterior nostrils
Lower limb of preopercle scaly
Pelvic fins long, reaching between anus and anal-fin origin; axillary scale present

atule_mate.distribution: Tamil Nadu and Kerala coasts and the Andamans; also Chilika Lake and the Godavari estuary
field_marks: Olive-green back shading to silvery-white belly
Black spot, slightly smaller than the eye, on the upper edge of the gill cover
Dorsal and tail fins dusky greenish-yellow; anal fin pale yellow
Last dorsal and anal rays finlet-like but attached (no separate finlets)
36–49 bony scutes on the straight rear part of the lateral line
Adipose eyelid covers the eye except for a vertical slit over the pupil

lutjanus_quinquelineatus.distribution: Indian seas; Indo-West Pacific from the Persian Gulf to Fiji
field_marks: Bright yellow body, fins yellow too
Series of blue horizontal stripes along the side
Round black spot, eye-sized or larger, below the front soft dorsal rays, mostly above the lateral line
Steeply sloping head profile
Clear notch and knob on the rear edge of the gill-cover bone
Tail nearly squared off (truncate)

megalaspis_cordyla.distribution: Coastal waters of India; also Chilika Lake (Odisha)
field_marks: Slender torpedo-shaped body; bluish-grey to green back, silvery sides and belly, dark fins
Large black spot on the upper rear edge of the gill cover
Row of separate finlets behind the dorsal (7–9) and anal (8–10) fins
Very large, strong scutes (51–59) along the whole lateral line
Strongly flattened tail stalk with a central keel; forked tail
Adipose eyelid covers the eye except for a vertical slit
